notes: Gold questions for the Q&A agent. 'facts' lists what a correct answer must state; each fact is a list of acceptable phrasings, matched case-insensitively after removing punctuation. 'evidence' lists the transcript lines a complete answer would cite. Unanswerable questions are about things the meetings never discussed; the correct behaviour is to say so. Development set: the agent prompt was written against these questions.

questions.question: Can patients book without creating an account?
What deposit do new patients pay, and when is it refunded?
How did the appointment reminder requirement change across meetings?
How will new bookings get into ClinicDesk, and why not through its API?
Is the waitlist part of the first release?
facts: not part of the first release
